semiconductor_relevance: High — Plasmatech Co., Ltd. specializes in environmental solutions for semiconductor manufacturing, focusing on air quality improvement and exhaust gas treatment.
summary: Plasmatech Co., Ltd. provides advanced environmental solutions for the semiconductor industry, utilizing proprietary plasma application technologies to enhance air quality and comply with environmental regulations. Their high-efficiency Wet Electrostatic Precipitator technology effectively removes fine particles and toxic gases from semiconductor manufacturing processes.
capabilities: DC Thermal Arc Plasma-based scrubber systems
De-NOx solution, ZeNoX™ for nitrogen oxides removal
